inputs: master.csv: market,code (cross-section lens is data_gap by construction)

lineage.source: Cooper, Gulen, Schill, Asset Growth and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns (Journal of Finance 2008)
lineage.note: 总资产高增长是否决信号; ≥50% 阈值为 canonical top-quintile 的声明替身 (无横截面资产史)

limits: no assets_prev anywhere in the snapshot — A: no total-assets field (a_balance has receivable/inventory only); HK: no balance sheet; US: us_financials has assets but no assets_prev
veto threshold 50% is a declared stand-in for the canonical top-quintile break (needs a full cross-section)
equity growth ≠ asset growth — never substitute (debt-funded expansion is exactly what this factor catches)
